Connor/Laura — I reviewed the KYC packet and ran a quick sanctions screen. The Cygnus US entity is clear, but their Group has a small R&D subsidiary in Hyderabad, India (Cygnus R&D Private Ltd). That in itself is not disqualifying, however: 
- We need a formal attestation from Cygnus that no restricted data (PHI that they don't control) will be sent during the pilot.
- For the dev-from-India ask, we should require Conditional Access: dev tokens tied to IP ranges and MFA, no model weight export, and logging forwarded to our audit bucket.
- The 25% discount exceeds Deal Desk delegation. Because this touches geo/access and non-standard audit terms, I recommend elevating to SVP Sales for a one-time exception and copying Legal (we need a carve-out in the MSA).

If Alta (SVP) signs off, we should condition approval on: signed attestation, limited pilot scope (max 3 seats with dev tokens), quarterly compliance reviews, and no agent access to admin controls.

—Aditya
